> Enkidu Hits you hands for 3, Blur, Hands for 3, Hands for 3, Bone Spur. If

Not if you have 2 or 5 blood. The punch for 3 (the second one, in the
case of 5) will send you to torpor, aggravated or not. No subsequent
additional strikes will be made (since combat will end). No burn.

What the hell are you guys talking about?

Bone Spur: Combat, 1 blood, Protean
[pro] For the remainder of this round, this vampire's hand damage is
aggravated.
[PRO] As above, but for the remainder of this combat.

Blur works fine with Bone Spur, and it lasts the whole round, as does Claws.
(at least SOME people read the card text.)

Claws were never _bad_, but they're largely a thing of the past.
Presses are a better way to handle an opponent who just wants to run
away or dodge; an opponent who wants to run away and shoot at you allows
you to conveniently cycle prevention, and you STILL get to poke his eye
out on the 2nd round.

Trap + superior Bone Spur = S:CE, kill me first, or die. Add Flesh of
Marble into this mix, and option "B" becomes noticeably less feasible.
Many vampires with Protean also have this "Fortitude" thing, further
helping decrease the probability of situation "B".

- --
Derek
